Portal swirl after the audit: drawn under the nicknames, health numbers and indicators (its halo reaches twice the radius). Bilinear in hardware - the data texture is LINEAR and repeats horizontally (texture::set_repeat_horizontally), 3 texture() instead of 12 texelFetch: RX 5700, the range with the portal in view, 3+3 alternating runs, GPU 0.519 -> 0.501 ms per frame. The fetches are skipped where the profile fades out below a quarter of the 8-bit step. The time comes wrapped at 7920 s, the common period of both spins and the cycle (209 and 154 turns, 7200 cycles), with the snapshot index modulo 7200 - no jump, and the float time keeps its precision however long the game runs. No negative % in GLSL; the data format and its constants described. The swirl takes both ring colors: the base in the outer one, the brightest grain leaning towards the inner one (packed as 0xRRGGBB into the last float of the special, the seed into the fraction of the radius in whole screen pixels). The presets' inner and outer colors are swapped, and the outer one is the portal's main color everywhere (flat rings, highlights, icons), so the portals look as before - the names now match what is seen. New presets: CYAN is pure cyan, TURQUOISE the former one, AMBER and ORANGE. The color preset combo shows each preset's outer and inner colors; switching to CUSTOM starts from the colors of the preset chosen before. Effect speed is shown only for the flat rings. Production builds: the portal particles' pool is 1 (was ~8 MB allocated and zeroed for nothing) and the spawner never runs.

Shooting range: the lights' intensities restored - saving the map with a build that didn't know them (5891063a0) reset 11 lights to 1.0, the big lamps went down from 1.24-1.4, so the range looked darker.

Fog of war audit fixes: the full fog of war area is computed for the minimap overlay only when the minimap can show at all (minimap_settings::can_draw_fog_of_war_overlay, also used where the overlay is drawn) - with the overlay color set and the minimap off, the rays were cast over the whole area again. When the fog of war area around the eye misses the screen, the rays stay in a box at the eye instead of reaching the world's origin (clip_by leaves an empty rect at 0,0). sector_aabb.h uses repro::cos/fabs, the 16 px snapping margin is named, the margins' comments say what they cover.
